context: A tutor and two students discuss their progress on a public transport usage survey project.

sub_blocks.word_limit: Choose the correct letter, A or B. A Emma. B Noah. Options are on the question paper only.

lines.text: Now turn to Section Three. You will hear a tutor and two students discussing a survey project.
Questions twenty-one to twenty-four. Complete the flowchart. Write no more than two words for each answer. First, you have some time to look at questions twenty-one to twenty-four.
Now listen and answer questions twenty-one to twenty-four.
So, Emma, Noah — where are you up to with the public transport survey?
We've just finished the literature review stage, actually.
Good. What comes next in your process?
Next we need to design the questionnaire itself, which we're working on this week.
And after that?
We'll run a small pilot test with about ten people before the real survey goes out.
Sensible. And the final step?
Then we launch the main survey to the wider public.
Questions twenty-five to twenty-seven. Complete the summary. Write one word only for each answer. First, you have some time to look at questions twenty-five to twenty-seven.
Now listen and answer questions twenty-five to twenty-seven.
What's been the hardest part of the process so far?
Honestly, recruitment — getting enough people to actually agree to take part.
That's very common. How are you addressing that?
We're offering a small incentive — a five-dollar voucher for anyone who completes it.
Good idea. And where are you distributing the survey itself?
Mainly online, through social media groups for now.
Questions twenty-eight to thirty. Choose the correct letter, A or B. The options are on your question paper only. First, you have some time to look at questions twenty-eight to thirty.
Now listen and answer questions twenty-eight to thirty.
Now, who's leading on the data analysis once responses come in?
That's me — I'll handle the analysis.
And who's writing up the methodology section?
I've got that one, along with the conclusion.
And who's finalising the conclusion, just to double check?
That's me as well.
Great, sounds well organised. Let's touch base again once the pilot's done.
Sounds good, thanks.
That is the end of Section Three. Now turn to Section Four.
